description: Single logical catalog for frozen repository data and external large BGP assets.

datasets.notes: Keep in place for reproducibility. Legacy workflow fields are not truth labels.
Complete 3,840-file Route Views SG and RIPE RIS RRC00 raw update archive set for 2024-04-07 through 2024-04-16; 16,502,107,268 bytes; final SHA256/compression revalidation passed.
Must be derived from the immutable raw MRT dataset through a manifest-bound parser run.

guardrails: Large raw and derived datasets stay outside git.
Repository configs and manifests identify every external dataset.
A missing external dataset is unavailable evidence, never an empty or benign observation.
Do not silently substitute the frozen 6h reference for the 10-day history dataset.
